answers.question: What does my plan have me doing this week, and why?
answers.text:

- Monday, August 31: Walk 15 minutes at a comfortable pace
- Tuesday, September 1: Rest day
- Wednesday, September 2: Walk 15 minutes at a comfortable pace
- Thursday, September 3: Rest day
- Friday, September 4: Walk 15 minutes at a comfortable pace
- Saturday, September 5: Rest day
- Sunday, September 6: Rest day

Base: Monday, August 31 to Sunday, September 13 (2 weeks). Establish a calm bedtime routine and easy walking rhythm to help regulate your sleep-wake cycle.

answers.question: What does my plan look like over the next few months?
answers.text:
Your long-term plan runs from Monday, August 31 to Sunday, November 22, spanning 9 phases over 12 weeks. It's built on your recent walking baseline of 0 min. You are currently in week 1 of the Base phase, which started Monday, August 31 and ends Sunday, September 13. The next phase begins Monday, September 14. Here's the phase-by-phase outline:

- Base: Monday, August 31 to Sunday, September 13 (2 weeks). Establish a calm bedtime routine and easy walking rhythm to help regulate your sleep-wake cycle.
- Build: Monday, September 14 to Sunday, September 20 (1 week). Add a slightly stronger walking stimulus to improve daytime energy without overdoing it.
- Recovery: Monday, September 21 to Sunday, September 27 (1 week). Step back and let your body absorb the new routine while noticing how sleep is responding.
- Build: Monday, September 28 to Sunday, October 11 (2 weeks). Return to active walking with a focus on staying calm and consistent through the afternoon.
- Recovery: Monday, October 12 to Sunday, October 18 (1 week). Recover with relaxed movement and make the bedtime habit feel more automatic.
- Base: Monday, October 19 to Sunday, October 25 (1 week). Reestablish a reliable base of easy walks to keep sleep pressure steady and energy stable.
- Build: Monday, October 26 to Sunday, November 1 (1 week). Add gentle variety to your walks so your body stays responsive without becoming exhausted.
- Recovery: Monday, November 2 to Sunday, November 8 (1 week). Use lighter movement to consolidate the gains in sleep quality and daytime alertness.
- Maintain: Monday, November 9 to Sunday, November 22 (2 weeks). Maintain the walking and bedtime rhythm that keeps your energy from dipping later in the day.

And the weekly sessions are as follows:

- Week 1, starting Monday, August 31 (Base): key session Easy (walk). Establish a calm bedtime routine and easy walking rhythm to help regulate your sleep-wake cycle.
- Week 2, starting Monday, September 7 (Base): key session Easy (walk). Keep the gentle movement habit steady so your body learns to relax more reliably at night.
- Week 3, starting Monday, September 14 (Build): key session Easy (walk). Add a slightly stronger walking stimulus to improve daytime energy without overdoing it.
- Week 4, starting Monday, September 21 (Recovery): key session Recovery (yoga). Step back and let your body absorb the new routine while noticing how sleep is responding.
- Week 5, starting Monday, September 28 (Build): key session Easy (walk). Return to active walking with a focus on staying calm and consistent through the afternoon.
- Week 6, starting Monday, October 5 (Build): key session Easy (walk). Increase the walking challenge a little to deepen fitness while protecting your wind-down.
- Week 7, starting Monday, October 12 (Recovery): key session Recovery (yoga). Recover with relaxed movement and make the bedtime habit feel more automatic.
- Week 8, starting Monday, October 19 (Base): key session Easy (walk). Reestablish a reliable base of easy walks to keep sleep pressure steady and energy stable.
- Week 9, starting Monday, October 26 (Build): key session Easy (walk). Add gentle variety to your walks so your body stays responsive without becoming exhausted.
- Week 10, starting Monday, November 2 (Recovery): key session Recovery (walk). Use lighter movement to consolidate the gains in sleep quality and daytime alertness.
- Week 11, starting Monday, November 9 (Maintain): key session Easy (walk). Maintain the walking and bedtime rhythm that keeps your energy from dipping later in the day.
- Week 12, starting Monday, November 16 (Maintain): key session Easy (walk). Sustain the full routine so steadier sleep and brighter afternoons become your normal pattern.
